surface_mechanism_description: The specific character of the ALD reactions consists of the sequential chemical adsorption and corresponding conversion of molecules of each precursor during half-reaction on the substrate. Analysis of our data shows that at adsorption of molecules of Et4Sn and their reaction with the functional surface groups, a change in the valence of a major part of the tin atoms from 4 to 2 takes place.
evidence: Analysis of our data shows that at adsorption of molecules of et4Sn and their reaction with the functional surface groups, a change in the valence of a major part of the tin atoms from 4 to 2 takes place.
